title: [006] Commit a synthetic fixture whose first writes bootstrap the allowlist

violation.problem: `pyric verify` replays from an empty database. The only capture relies on allowlist docs seeded outside the session (3 state-drift failures) and contains real emails.
violation.expectedSolution: Capture from a fresh sandbox with `studio:allowlist add alice@example.test bob@example.test --local` as the first action, then the alice/bob/mallory journey. Commit it with synthetic identities only.
